correctness.rationale: The exact conditional triangle-birth probability is 2D/q², and the root degree is a sum of independent Bernoulli indicators. Summing its mean yields the displayed two-term expectation tail; the exact two-arrival moment identity bounds total pair coincidence by O((log N)²/N²). Bonferroni yields the probability asymptotics; summability and tail integration prove a.s. finiteness and sharp moments. Exact rational 14,400-configuration enumeration, 15 moments and 36 finite-window DP checks agree. The finite checks are not substituted for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A natural, explicitly motivated root-motif statistic in a widely studied random recursive DAG exhibits the striking coexistence of finitely many root triangles a.s. and an infinite expected last-birth time. The exact logarithmic-over-linear survival tail and sharp moment cutoff quantify a high-age instability relevant to motif-based network archaeology, beyond the known unmarked triangle-count asymptotics. No general paper-scale downstream theorem is asserted.
